overall_summary: The channel shows very low overall view counts across all 7 videos, making statistical confidence extremely low. However, slightly better performance (20 views) was observed on grounded, relational topics involving everyday relics like old phone numbers, compared to more abstract night thoughts.

winning_patterns.evidence: Video A_eLARoegnw ('आज भी फोन में तुम्हारा नाम सुरक्षित है') got 20 views, the highest in the dataset.
winning_patterns.action: Focus hooks on concrete, universally relatable digital artifacts like saved numbers, chats, or profile pictures.

weak_patterns.evidence: Video WhJ-VwRa3Rg ('घंटों से वो ऑनलाइन दिख रहा है') received only 3 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid passive observation hooks; ground the opening in a direct personal action or tangible object.
